specs.title: off until connected: the launcher opens a setup pointer, and no provider is ever contacted
setup with an API key (MOCK OpenAI): test, pick a model, connect, chat; the key travels in a header only and is never stored
"Remember on this device" seals the key in the encrypted store without plaintext; Turn off ZIGi removes it
Disconnect removes every key this account remembered on the device, an earlier provider's too
Habits: two proposals in one reply become cards, "Add all" writes through the habit store, one Undo restores both
Health: water and an AI-estimated food; unknown stays unknown; Edit re-validates; Add writes and Undo removes
Wealth: money only pre-fills the add-asset form, which the person submits
Wealth: an account's balance only pre-fills that account's balance form, which the person saves
prompt injection: a record titled like an instruction can at most become one proposal card
the context is only what the page shares: Settings reads nothing, the switch can hold data back, and the preview shows the exact text
Today's data carries the review week from the weekly review on this device; no Health lines while Health is not shared
hide with Undo, the Settings switch, ⌘K / Ctrl+K and focus back on the launcher
sensitive screens: the launcher is away while Settings shows the sign-in form and while a sheet is open
motion: the pending indicator and ZIGi hold still under reduced motion and Motion Off; the reply still streams
phone: a full-height sheet with a 16 px composer, the launcher above the tabs and away while More is open

phone layout only

specs.title: Showcase: keys are session-only and the chat lives in the tab

offline: a calm card that says a model on this computer would keep working; a local server that does not answer says the same
phone: a denied microphone shows the steps for this browser and the composer stays usable; the keyboard inset lifts the composer
